materiality: Adds a DeepSeek V4.1 FlashMLA mega-attention execution path.
Adds an NVFP4 compressed KV-cache record path distinct from the existing FP8 cache format.
Changes fused Q/KV preparation, cache insertion and sparse decode execution, so loader or model admission evidence cannot qualify it.
requiredEvidence: Bind the exact vLLM source revision plus the exact executed wheel or container digest, FlashMLA dependency identity, CUDA/driver/compiler and accelerator identity, and the exact DeepSeek V4.1 model/tokenizer/encoding source already governed by Frontier #134.

Prove the FP8 and NVFP4 compressed-cache record layouts, bytes-per-token, scaling and quantize/dequantize semantics with independent deterministic reference fixtures; mixed or stale cache formats must fail explicitly rather than be silently accepted.

Compare the fused mega-attention path against the split-KV reference path under fixed seeds and predeclared tolerances across prefill, decode, sliding-window and compressed-cache cases, including ragged/page-boundary inputs and the local-head/TP configurations actually exercised.
Bind any SM100/Blackwell-specific result to the exact hardware lane. Unsupported or unavailable hardware is UNAVAILABLE, never an inferred PASS, and an unexercised kernel remains UNQUALIFIED.

Exercise cache lifecycle, cancellation, worker restart, request isolation, malformed metadata and rollback to the incumbent exact runtime; no correctness result may depend on an implicit fallback that is not captured in the receipt.
Measure memory, latency and throughput only after correctness gates pass; upstream benchmark numbers remain upstream-reported until reproduced by SZL.

materiality: Fixes Kimi-K3 KDA metadata that could classify a stateless first chunk as decode instead of prefill.
Changes recurrent-state initialization semantics while preserving resumed one-token decode and CUDA-graph capture behavior.
requiredEvidence: Bind the exact vLLM source and executed artifact plus the exact Kimi-K3 model/tokenizer revision and runtime environment; moving vLLM main inherits no qualification.

Use deterministic fixtures that distinguish a true stateless first chunk, a resumed one-token chunk, padding rows and a missing prefill flag, and verify state initialization occurs only for the true first-chunk case.
Prove full CUDA-graph capture remains decode-only and that recycled or stale recurrent state cannot leak into a new request; include pointer/state-index invariants where the runtime exposes them.
Exercise non-speculative and speculative paths, mixed batches, concurrent requests, cancellation and worker restart with fixed-seed output parity against the independent incumbent reference.

Malformed or contradictory sequence/query/prefill metadata must fail closed or produce an explicitly classified unsupported state; it must not silently select a decode kernel with uninitialized recurrent state.
Preserve rollback to the incumbent exact Kimi-K3 runtime and keep all production model/provider/default and Hugging Face projection state unchanged until the normal gates pass.

materiality: Adds DeepSeek V4.1 distributed communication kernels and Python wrappers after the exact SGLang source previously governed by the Sep-16 kernel-stack wave.
Introduces fused communication/finalization behavior whose rank ordering, synchronization, dtype and topology semantics require independent distributed qualification.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact SGLang source/build/JIT bytes plus the Frontier #134 DeepSeek V4.1 model/tokenizer/encoding source and exact CUDA/compiler/driver/NCCL-or-equivalent/runtime/device topology identities.

Reference-check each exercised communication primitive and wrapper for world size, rank mapping, counts, dtype, empty/ragged inputs, dropped-slot behavior, bounds and output parity against an unfused or independently implemented reference.
Run distributed evidence only on actual supported multi-accelerator hardware. Missing topology is UNAVAILABLE rather than PASS, and primitives not reached by an execution receipt remain UNQUALIFIED.

Stress deterministic rank ordering and synchronization under repeated execution and exercise timeout, peer/process failure, cancellation, restart and stale-workspace or phase-counter behavior without deadlock or cross-request contamination.
Run fixed-seed end-to-end DeepSeek V4.1 correctness against the previously governed exact SGLang kernel-stack source before measuring any fused communication performance benefit.

Preserve an explicit rollback to the previous exact SGLang source/runtime; no production route/default, autonomous tool authority, Hugging Face projection or public capability/proof claim is authorized by source support alone.
